issue.body:
See https://buildkite.com/iree/iree-android-arm64-v8a/builds/908#995e8735-2dfd-4937-90b0-7bd8c4cafd44:

```
[ RUN      ] AllDrivers/CommandQueueTest.BlockingSubmit/vulkan
I ../iree/hal/cts/cts_test_base.h:88] Reusing existing driver 'vulkan'...
I ../iree/hal/cts/cts_test_base.h:66] Creating default device...
I ../iree/hal/vulkan/vulkan_driver.cc:295] Created Vulkan Device: Adreno (TM) 640
I ../iree/hal/cts/cts_test_base.h:68] Created device 'Adreno (TM) 640'
../iree/hal/cts/command_queue_test.cc:73: Failure
Value of: command_queue->Submit( {{}, {command_buffer.get()}, {{semaphore.get(), 1ull}}})
Expected: is OK
  Actual: INTERNAL: VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED (of type iree::Status), which is not OK
F ../iree/hal/vulkan/emulated_timeline_semaphore.cc:56] Check failed: outstanding_semaphores_.empty() Destroying an emulated timeline semaphore without first waiting on outstanding signals
Aborted 
```

This is likely an Andreo specific issue. I suspect it's because we are submitting empty command buffers.
issue.title: Command queue CTS tests failing for Adreno GPUs

issue.body:
They are failing with VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED. This is
likely an Adreno specific issue; so instead of turning off the
tests completely for all Vulkan ICDs, only disable for Adreno
GPUs.

Progress towards https://github.com/google/iree/issues/2907

issue.body:
Part of https://github.com/google/iree/issues/4494 for migrating to Vulkan 1.2
Related to https://github.com/google/iree/issues/2907 for enabling tests that were previously failing with emulation

This requires that all of our test configurations support timeline semaphores:
- [x] Desktop SwiftShader CPU (may require a version bump)
  * [`bazel_linux_x86-swiftshader_core` failure logs](https://source.cloud.google.com/results/invocations/08badaac-d47e-42e8-8efa-7f7f2074d0a3/targets/iree%2Fgcp_ubuntu%2Fbazel%2Flinux%2Fx86-swiftshader%2Fcore%2Fpresubmit/log): `/install-swiftshader/swiftshader/src/Vulkan/VkSemaphore.cpp:123 WARNING: nextInfo->sType = 1000207002` -- blocked on https://github.com/google/iree/issues/7419
  * [`cmake_linux_x86-swiftshader` mostly passing logs](https://source.cloud.google.com/results/invocations/7b9ab706-94f6-4e6d-a6c9-2751df6477e0/targets/iree%2Fgcp_ubuntu%2Fcmake%2Flinux%2Fx86-swiftshader%2Fpresubmit/log): just semaphore_test timeouts in a test I tried to enable again
- [x] Desktop NVIDIA GPU (if we're testing there; may require a driver update)
  * [`cmake_linux_x86-turing` logs](https://source.cloud.google.com/results/invocations/b8c4f44a-ca14-43ee-860a-14c50033629d/targets): success
- [x] Android GPU (may require more recent hardware up to date on OS patches)
  * [`iree-android-arm64-v8a` logs](https://buildkite.com/iree/iree-android-arm64-v8a/builds/5526) - Galaxy S10 passes tests, Galaxy S20 timed out (?), ~~Pixel 4 fails them (can we switch to a newer Pixel phone for testing?)~~
    * We no longer test correctness on Pixel 4?
  * ~~[`iree-benchmark` logs](https://buildkite.com/iree/iree-benchmark/builds/1779) - Pixel 4 failed, Pixel 6 succeeded, no summary comment for easy analysis~~
    * Fixed by disabling Vulkan benchmarks on Pixel 4 (we still benchmark on Pixel 6 and Moto Edge X30)
